specialty_focus: Surgipharm is a regional healthcare group focused on the importation, marketing, and last-mile distribution of pharmaceuticals, medical equipment, and health supplies . It partners with major multinational and WHO-approved manufacturers to supply hospitals, clinics, NGOs, and governments across East African nations like Kenya, Uganda, and Rwanda. Surgipharm Limited Product Categories Branded & Generic Pharmaceuticals: Essential, lifestyle, and life-saving drugs including antiretrovirals (ARVs).
